knowledge:
- key_parameters: bpProportion=TRUE ;; If TRUE, calculates proportional overlap (percentage of base pairs falling into each class) instead of priority-based region classification. ;; numbers=TRUE ;; If TRUE, plots raw overlap counts instead of percentages in partition plots. ;; tile=TRUE ;; If TRUE, plots a tiled version aligning multiple datasets vertically in feature distance plots. ;; labelOrder="center" ;; Sorts datasets based on values in the center bins in feature distance plots. ;; pval=TRUE ;; Displays Chi-square significance stars on expected partition plots. ;; rawCounts=TRUE ;; Returns actual counts of dinucleotides per region instead of frequencies. ;; bins=7 ;; Manually adjusts the number of bins in width histograms. ;; metadata=cellTypeMetadata ;; Adds metadata-based coloring to signal plots. ;; colorColumn="tissueType" ;; Specifies the column in the metadata table to use for coloring signal plots.
- alternatives: GenomicDistributionsData ;; A companion package containing full-size reference datasets (hg19, hg38, mm9, mm10) that should be preferred over the limited built-in hg19 reference in GenomicDistributions. ;; biomaRt or EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86 ;; External packages used to fetch custom features, gene models, or regulatory elements (like enhancers) when built-in annotations are insufficient.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have one or more sets of genomic ranges (e.g., ChIP-seq peaks, ATAC-seq peaks, enhancers) and want to characterize their global properties, genomic distribution, relationship to genomic features (like TSSs, exons, introns), or sequence properties (GC content, dinucleotide frequency).
- pitfalls: Naive partition plots (percentage partition plots) are not corrected for genomic background, which can be misleading because most of the genome is intergenic; expected partition plots should be used to correct for this. ;; Priority-based partition classification (default) classifies a region based on highest priority overlap (e.g., promoter > exon > intron > intergenic) and does not test lower priorities once an overlap is found; use bpProportion=TRUE if proportional base-pair overlap is desired. ;; GC content and dinucleotide frequency plots require large BSgenome packages, which are not included and must be installed separately.

workflows.name: genomic_range_characterization
workflows.intent: Characterize and visualize basic properties of genomic ranges including chromosome distribution, distance to TSS/features, genomic partitions, neighbor distances, widths, and sequence content.
input: vistaEnhancers.bed.gz (BED file of genomic ranges of interest)
setB_100.bed.gz (additional BED file of genomic ranges for comparison)
workflows.stages:
1. Load query genomic ranges using rtracklayer::import.
2. Calculate and plot chromosome distribution using calcChromBinsRef and plotChromBins.
3. Calculate and plot distance to TSS or custom features using calcFeatureDistRefTSS (or calcFeatureDist) and plotFeatureDist.
4. Calculate and plot genomic partition distributions (percentage, expected, cumulative) using calcPartitionsRef, calcExpectedPartitionsRef, calcCumulativePartitionsRef and their corresponding plot functions (plotPartitions, plotExpectedPartitions, plotCumulativePartitions).
5. Calculate and plot neighboring region distances using calcNeighborDist and plotNeighborDist.
6. Calculate and plot width distributions using calcWidth and plotQTHist.
7. Calculate and plot GC content and dinucleotide frequencies using calcGCContentRef, plotGCContent, calcDinuclFreqRef, and plotDinuclFreq.
workflows.code:
library("GenomicDistributions")
queryFile = system.file("extdata", "vistaEnhancers.bed.gz", package="GenomicDistributions")
query = rtracklayer::import(queryFile)
x = calcChromBinsRef(query, "hg19")
plotChromBins(x)
query2 = GenomicRanges::shift(query, 1e6)
queryList = GRangesList(vistaEnhancers=query, shifted=query2)
x2 = calcChromBinsRef(queryList, "hg19")
plotChromBins(x2)
TSSdist = calcFeatureDistRefTSS(query, "hg19")
plotFeatureDist(TSSdist, featureName="TSS")
TSSdist2 = calcFeatureDistRefTSS(queryList, "hg19")
plotFeatureDist(TSSdist2, featureName="TSS")
plotFeatureDist(TSSdist2, featureName="TSS", tile=TRUE, labelOrder = "center")
featureExample = GenomicRanges::shift(query, round(rnorm(length(query), 0,1000)))
fdd = calcFeatureDist(query, featureExample)
plotFeatureDist(fdd)
gp = calcPartitionsRef(query, "hg19")
plotPartitions(gp)
gp2 = calcPartitionsRef(queryList, "hg19")
plotPartitions(gp2)
plotPartitions(gp2, numbers=TRUE)
gp3 = calcPartitionsRef(queryList, "hg19", bpProportion=TRUE)
plotPartitions(gp3)
ep = calcExpectedPartitionsRef(query, "hg19")
plotExpectedPartitions(ep)
ep2 = calcExpectedPartitionsRef(queryList, "hg19")
plotExpectedPartitions(ep2)
plotExpectedPartitions(ep2, pval=TRUE)
ep3 = calcExpectedPartitionsRef(queryList, "hg19", bpProportion=TRUE)
plotExpectedPartitions(ep3)
cp = calcCumulativePartitionsRef(query, "hg19")
plotCumulativePartitions(cp)
cp2 = calcCumulativePartitionsRef(queryList, "hg19")
plotCumulativePartitions(cp2)
nd = calcNeighborDist(query)
plotNeighborDist(nd)
s = system.file("extdata", "setB_100.bed.gz", package="GenomicDistributions")
setB = rtracklayer::import(s)
queryList2 = GRangesList(vistaEnhancers=query, setB=setB)
dist2 = calcNeighborDist(queryList2)
plotNeighborDist(dist2)
gc1 = calcGCContentRef(query, "hg19")
plotGCContent(gc1)
gc2 = calcGCContentRef(queryList, "hg19")
plotGCContent(gc2)
df1 = calcDinuclFreqRef(query, "hg19")
plotDinuclFreq(df1)
df2=calcDinuclFreqRef(queryList, "hg19")
plotDinuclFreq(df2)
df3=calcDinuclFreqRef(queryList, "hg19", rawCounts=TRUE)
plotDinuclFreq(df3)
qt1 = calcWidth(query)
plotQTHist(qt1)
qt2 = calcWidth(queryList)
plotQTHist(qt2)
plotQTHist(qt1, bins=7, EndBarColor = 'black', MiddleBarColor='darkblue')

workflows.name: signal_in_regions
workflows.intent: Summarize and plot signal values (such as tissue specificity or open chromatin accessibility) across conditions of interest for a set of genomic ranges.
input: example_cell_matrix.txt (matrix of signal values across conditions/cell types)
workflows.stages:
1. Load query genomic ranges and the signal matrix.
2. Calculate summary signal across regions using calcSummarySignal.
3. Plot summary signal using plotSummarySignal (with options for bar, violin, box, or jitter plots, and optional metadata-based coloring).
workflows.code:
library("GenomicDistributions")
queryFile = system.file("extdata", "vistaEnhancers.bed.gz", package="GenomicDistributions")
query = rtracklayer::import(queryFile)
query2 = GenomicRanges::shift(query, 1e6)
queryList = GRangesList(vistaEnhancers=query, shifted=query2)
exampleCellMatrixFile = system.file("extdata", "example_cell_matrix.txt", package="GenomicDistributions")
cellMatrix = data.table::fread(exampleCellMatrixFile)
op = calcSummarySignal(query, cellMatrix)
plotSummarySignal(op)
op2 = calcSummarySignal(queryList, cellMatrix)
plotSummarySignal(op2)
cellTypeMetadata = cellTypeMetadata
plotSummarySignal(op2, metadata = cellTypeMetadata, colorColumn = "tissueType")
plotSummarySignal(signalSummaryList = op2, plotType = "violinPlot", metadata = cellTypeMetadata, colorColumn = "tissueType")

workflows.name: custom_reference_and_features
workflows.intent: Generate custom reference data (chromosome sizes, TSS, gene models) from FASTA/GTF files or add custom partitions (e.g., enhancers) to partition lists.
workflows.stages:
1. Extract chromosome sizes from FASTA using getChromSizesFromFasta and generate genome bins using getGenomeBins.
2. Extract TSS locations from GTF using getTssFromGTF.
3. Extract gene models from GTF using getGeneModelsFromGTF and build a partition list using genomePartitionList.
4. Alternatively, fetch custom features (e.g., enhancers) using biomaRt and append them to a standard partition list.
workflows.code:
fastaSource = "http://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-103/fasta/caenorhabditis_elegans/dna/Caenorhabditis_elegans.WBcel235.dna.toplevel.fa.gz"
gtfSource = "http://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-103/gtf/caenorhabditis_elegans/Caenorhabditis_elegans.WBcel235.103.gtf.gz"
CEelegansChromSizes = getChromSizesFromFasta(source=fastaSource)
bins = getGenomeBins(CEelegansChromSizes)
CEelegansTSSs = getTssFromGTF(source=gtfSource, convertEnsemblUCSC=TRUE)
features = c("gene", "exon", "three_prime_utr", "five_prime_utr")
CEelegansGeneModels = getGeneModelsFromGTF(source=gtfSource, features=features, convertEnsemblUCSC=TRUE)
partitionList = genomePartitionList(CEelegansGeneModels$gene,
                                    CEelegansGeneModels$exon,
                                    CEelegansGeneModels$three_prime_utr,
                                    CEelegansGeneModels$five_prime_utr)
funcgen = biomaRt::useMart("ENSEMBL_MART_FUNCGEN", host="grch37.ensembl.org")
funcgen = biomaRt::useDataset("hsapiens_regulatory_feature", mart=funcgen)
enhancers = biomaRt::getBM(attributes=c('chromosome_name',
                                        'chromosome_start',
                                        'chromosome_end',
                                        'feature_type_name'),
                  filters='regulatory_feature_type_name',
                  values='Enhancer',
                  mart=funcgen)
enhancers$chromosome_name = paste("chr", enhancers$chromosome_name, sep="")
gr1 = GenomicRanges::sort(GenomeInfoDb::sortSeqlevels(
    GenomicDistributions::dtToGr(enhancers,
                                 chr="chromosome_name",
                                 start="chromosome_start",
                                 end="chromosome_end")))
geneModels = GenomicDistributions::getGeneModels("hg19")
partitionList = GenomicDistributions::genomePartitionList(geneModels$genesGR,
                                                          geneModels$exonsGR,
                                                          geneModels$threeUTRGR,
                                                          geneModels$fiveUTRGR)
partitionList[["enhancer"]] = gr1
